faq.a: It depends on each excursion. When we quote, we tell you whether there's pickup at your stay or a meeting point, and the schedule.
There are both. Shared ones are more affordable; private ones adapt to your pace and your group.

faq.q: What if the weather is bad?
faq.a: If the provider cancels due to weather or authority instructions, we offer another date or a refund for that service.
Some activities, like buggies or zip lines, have a minimum age and safety rules. We confirm them when you book.

TransfersPage.lead: Private round-trip transfers from Punta Cana airport (PUJ), in the vehicle that best fits your group.
TransfersPage.summary: From Punta Cana International Airport (PUJ) it is about a 15-minute drive to Cap Cana, 25 to 30 minutes to Bávaro and Los Corales, 45 minutes to Uvero Alto, 1 h 15 min to Bayahíbe and La Romana and 2 h 30 min to Santo Domingo. Our transfers are private, round trip and available at any time, by sedan, SUV, van, minibus or coach depending on your group, with the price confirmed before you pay.

faq.q: What details do you need for the transfer?
faq.a: Date, flight number, number of people and bags, and the address of your stay.

faq.q: What if my flight is delayed?
faq.a: With your flight number we coordinate the pickup time. If anything changes, message us on WhatsApp and we'll adjust.

faq.q: Do you offer transfers from Santo Domingo?
faq.a: Yes, we also organize transfers to and from Santo Domingo and other parts of the country.

AboutPage.title: A local team that organizes your Punta Cana trip
AboutPage.lead: Conexión Caribe is a travel concierge based in the Dominican Republic. We coordinate your stay, transfers, excursions and services so that when you arrive, all you have to do is enjoy it.
AboutPage.summary: Conexión Caribe is a company registered in the Dominican Republic that organizes trips in Punta Cana, Bávaro, Cap Cana, Bayahíbe and La Romana. We work with local providers we know, answer on WhatsApp in English, Spanish and French, and confirm availability and price before you pay.
who: We are a local team in Punta Cana. We know the beaches, the routes and the providers in the area, and we use that knowledge to plan trips without surprises: your transfer is waiting at the airport, your stay is ready and every excursion has a confirmed time.

We don't sell fixed packages. We ask when you arrive, who is traveling and what you enjoy, and we propose a tailor-made itinerary with a single contact for the whole trip, before and during your stay.
